strongs_1890.strongs_def: a stream (as flowing); also an ear of grain (as growing out); by analogy, a branch
strongs_1890.derivation: or (feminine) שִׁבֹּלֶת; from the same as H7640 (שֹׁבֶל);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: branch, channel, ear (of corn), (water-)flood, Shibboleth. Compare H5451 (סִבֹּלֶת).
